endpoints.validation: OSM has no substation named Cornelia, so the town centroid is used. The route (Cornelia - Chase Road - Clarksville - Hollywood - Tallulah) fits: Chase Rd is at 34.536,-83.52 near Cornelia, and Hollywood Substation (115 kV, OSM way/52566972) is at 34.6475,-83.4547.

endpoints.name: Tallulah Lodge
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/52567096 power=substation name='Talulah Falls Substation' voltage=115000
endpoints.validation: The name does not match exactly ('Tallulah Lodge' vs 'Talulah Falls'). But the OSM line 'Talulah Falls - Toccoa 115kV' (way/1060215660) ends here. Its 16.5 km straight-line length to Toccoa Primary matches the plan's 10.3 mi Tallulah Lodge - Toccoa 115 kV line, and the historic Tallulah Lodge was at Tallulah Falls. Rabun/Habersham County.

projects.notes: Rebuild of about 9.7 mi across the Cornelia - Chase Road - Clarksville - Hollywood segments.

endpoints.name: Middle Fork (GTC)
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/52460256 power=substation substation=transmission voltage=230000 (unnamed)
endpoints.validation: The IRP says Middle Fork is an existing GTC 230 kV substation (GTC Middle Fork STATCOM; Hartwell Energy-Middle Fork 230 kV line). The IRP (p.418 area) says a new 500 kV yard will be built there. This unnamed 230 kV transmission substation is about 4 km from the Middle Fork Broad River (Franklin County). A 230 kV line runs south from it toward Center Primary (34.053,-83.398), which fits a SERTP 'Center Primary - Middle Fork 230 kV' line. It sits next to the existing 'South Hall - Oconee' 500 kV line, which would suit a new 500 kV yard. It is about 54 mi straight-line from McGrau Ford, which fits the plan's 64-65 mi. The feature is not named, so the match is unconfirmed.

projects.notes: A 500 kV line of about 64 mi, need date 2033.

endpoints.name: Gainesville #1
endpoints.coordinateSource: OSM way/1037359840 power=substation name='Gainesville Primary Substation (#1)' operator=Georgia Power voltage=115000;46000
endpoints.validation: The name matches '#1', and it is GPC with a 115 kV yard, matching the '115 kV main bus'. Hall County. Gainesville #2 is a separate station (way/179716524).

projects.notes: Although the title names a line, the work is only a main-bus replacement at Gainesville #1, so it is modeled as a substation. The other terminal, Dawson Crossing (GPC 230/115 kV), is OSM way/177912657 at 34.37812,-84.13358.
